camera.motion: static (background is a SAM-replaced smooth blue gradient; person feet fixed at y~543 all clip)

intrinsics_assumed.note: lab convention f = 0.5959*W, used in the ball cone fit

camera.perspective_cues: no floor/horizon visible (background replaced). Ball rolls toward the camera and down-left; its apparent diameter grows 118 -> ~280 px, i.e. its distance shrinks by ~2.4x.

objects.name: ball
objects.desc: large dark-grey (exercise/gym) ball with white specular highlights; the only ball
objects.visible_frames: 0-46 (fully in frame 0-32; cut by bottom edge 33-46; gone 47-48)
objects.reference_point: center_proj_x/y = image projection of the 3D sphere centre (cone fit); ell_cx/cy = centre of silhouette ellipse; vis_cx/cy = visible-mask centroid

objects.name: person
objects.desc: one person in black hoodie/black trousers, white shoes, face blurred, crouching/squatting behind the ball; pushes the ball toward the camera then raises arms
objects.moves: stays in place (crouched, feet fixed); arms/torso move
objects.note: frames 0-16 the lower body/feet are hidden behind the ball, so person bbox there is only head-to-arms (height ~122 px).

objects.name: watermark
objects.desc: 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' text box bottom-right (x>1030, y>690); not a scene object

events.event: ball held still against the person (hands on ball)
ball starts moving (push begins; centre first shifts ~1 px at f13, clearly from f14)
release: hands leave ball, arms fly up (person bbox height jumps 128->192 px)
ball bottom reaches image bottom edge
last frame with ball visible (tiny sliver at bottom-left)
person lowers arms back to knees

ball_motion_summary_px.direction: toward camera, image motion down-left, roughly straight; no bounce seen (rolling on the floor)
